purpose: Teach: 巫女/出土/事変/病原/徴候/定式/諸氏/カルテル

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、神社の、本気で、絶対、巫女、絶対、文化、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Sakura, your paper on shrine miko culture was genuinely impressive — the depth of research really struck me.
lines.style: Warm, genuine praise. Steady eye contact. Slight pause before naming the topic, as if recalling the paper with care. Conversational and direct, not performative.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。古代遺跡から、本気で、絶対、出土、絶対、した、絶対、土器、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you, sensei. I traced the pottery back to ancient excavations — I wanted to show the full historical depth.
lines.style: Respectful but not stiff. Genuine gratitude underneath. Slight lift in energy when explaining her research choice, like she's sharing something she cares about, not just reciting.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時の、本気で、絶対、満州、絶対、事変、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で、感心
lines.en: And you handled the Manchurian Incident period so carefully — your scope was really impressive.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured. Leaning slightly forward with genuine interest. Acknowledging intellectual work, not just effort. Warm but precise.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。感染症の、本気で、絶対、病原、絶対、菌、絶対、研究史、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I wanted to examine how infectious diseases were understood in that era — it felt important to the larger picture.
lines.style: Focused, slightly earnest. Speaking to something she actually thought through. Not rushed. A hint of satisfaction that it landed.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 文明衰退の、本気で、絶対、徴候、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The way you connected all of that to civilizational patterns was remarkable — very mature scholarship.
lines.style: Genuine admiration. Slow, deliberate. Speaking as one thinker to another, not teacher to student in the traditional sense. Respectful.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。歴史学の、本気で、絶対、定式、絶対、化、絶対、過程、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I tried to trace how historical methodology itself developed — how historians actually *think* about these patterns.
lines.style: Clear and direct. A flash of real pride underneath the politeness. She's explaining something she genuinely worked out, not rehearsed.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 明治期の学者、本気で、絶対、諸氏、絶対、の業績、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The scholarship on Meiji-era academics was particularly well-integrated — you clearly read beyond the surface.
lines.style: Warm nod of recognition. Speaking slowly, as if confirming something she's noted about Sakura. Genuine respect in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。戦前の、本気で、絶対、企業、絶対、カルテル、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes — I studied how corporate cartels operated before the war. It seemed to show how systems actually functioned beneath the ideology.
lines.style: Clear, thoughtful conclusion. A touch of satisfaction at having tied it together. Respectful but confident in what she's accomplished.
